works.title: Response Spinner
works.description: AI-powered tool that takes right-wing attacks as input, performs research to identify the actual impacts on affected populations, and generates forceful responses that redirect discourse to the real costs. Features technique-recognition library, anti-hallucination guardrails, and DEFCON-level escalation of rhetorical volume.
works.quote: My response spinner that I've come up with essentially takes a right wing attack. Has AI do the research and then come up with an answer that is essentially ignores the bullshit and just say here is here is the cost to to the affected people

works.title: The Reverse Prince: Architecture of Authoritarian Resistance
works.description: A book framing resistance to authoritarianism as a mirror inversion of Machiavelli's The Prince. Outlines a three-stage framework addressing soft-capture (narrative legitimacy), institutional capture (procedural hardball), and late-stage consolidation, showing how to build counter-power at each stage.
works.quote: I keep coming back to this thread because it's been so productive. I had a related idea that I don't think I've... one of those more distant often to the future books... Machiavelli but reversed - instead of 'how to hold power,' it's 'how to build resistance'
works.possible_duplicate_of: Shit-Testing the Tyrant OR Patent Salting / Prior Art Saboteur

works.title: Ideation Framework
works.description: A structured framework for transforming raw creative material into organized, implementable narrative elements using character choice architecture and universal human pattern recognition. Outputs include narrative recap, story beats, character choices, story elements, narrative elements, and context reinforcement sections.
works.quote: This framework transforms raw creative material into organized, implementable narrative elements. It uses character choice architecture and universal human pattern recognition to distill broad concepts into a target of concise, formatted story beats
